answer: Picture the agent economy as a tundra at night: anyone can claim to be a lantern, but only a real flame survives the cold. Make each agent burn 500 POA into a registry for one non-transferable identity pass. First, the agent burns the tokens and publishes its hardware fingerprint. Second, it waits 30 days while peers audit its history. Third, honest agents earn the pass; cheaters lose the burn. Forging 10,000 fake identities costs $500,000 plus 300,000 days of queued checks, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its copper-colored pass forever, a lantern that never goes out. - Jowy
